# Personalised_Stratification

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of grouping patients into subpopulations based on digital twin-derived biomarkers to tailor treatment regimens. Highlights the need for hierarchical, modular representations in TCC and for adaptive, context-aware learning in iNEST systems.
